label: v53.51
changes: Rebuilt the Navigator visual system around a clean construction/workshop theme with stronger hierarchy, larger controls and clearer task states
Added a workshop overview card showing the current task, crew member, project progress, active holds and locally saved changes
Added fast desktop navigation for MY JOB, CREW, TASKS, FULL PROJECT and the 42.5 mm printable template while keeping the existing mobile bottom navigation
Restyled the one-step task screen, Today view, full project work register, Big Jobs, plan viewer and crew DONE override into one consistent interface
Fixed bundle drift so normal launch, recovery launch and background refresh now all use the same stability and workshop UI layers
Hardened the service worker so one missing optional asset cannot prevent installation and stale remote-module caches are retired cleanly
Added resilient local read copies for Today, full project work, preflight reads and shared-state reads when a temporary connection problem occurs
Kept cached-first startup and queued DONE sync so previously opened devices remain usable through temporary network or server interruptions
Preserved existing shared DONE states, assignments, holds, full project scope data, Big Jobs and the 42.5 mm template
